g.text: Recorded human consequences are concentrated and structurally heterogeneous

text.style: font-size: 5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6f6f

g.text: Panels a and b use available numeric outcomes. Panel c models log(count + 1) among records with reported building size and GDP (deaths n=177; injuries n=127); injury estimates use stabilized reporting weights, while death reporting exceeds 95%. Associations are exploratory, conditional on documentation and not incidence effects.
